card.name: Scattered words in dosing instructions
card.fires_on: No single word or setting; it fires on unrelated words in dosing and monitoring sentences of drug labels.

modes.label: Comparison and timing words
modes.description: Small words in label instructions such as 'compared' or 'first' before a duration or condition.
